variants.name: 11.4 kg
variants.about_this_item:
Your high-energy dog is busy, whether they’re racing around the dog park, or acing agility courses. That’s why ACANA™ Sport & Agility is packed with protein and fat from animal sources, supporting sustained activity and endurance to keep up with your active dog. Featuring chicken, wildcaught flounder, and eggs that are delivered to our kitchen fresh or raw* by people we know and trust, ACANA™ nourishes dogs completely, keeping them happy, healthy, and strong.

1. 75%** QUALITY ANIMAL INGREDIENTS | PROTEIN-RICH & NUTRIENT-DENSE
2. 1/3 OF ANIMAL INGREDIENTS ARE FRESH OR RAW POULTRY AND FISH
3. 3 ANIMAL PROTEIN VARIETIES | FROM SUPPLIERS WE KNOW AND TRUST
4. WHOLEPREY | POULTRY, FISH, ORGANS AND BONE
5. FREEZE-DRY INFUSED | INTENSE NATURAL FLAVOUR
6. WHOLE VEGETABLES, FRUIT & BOTANICALS | FRESH
7. NO GRAIN INGREDIENTS***


*Our fresh ingredients use refrigeration as the sole method of preservation and our raw ingredients are frozen at the peak of freshness to preserve nutrients.
**Approximate and derived from the unprocessed state of the ingredients.
*** Produced in a facility that processes grains
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition

Fresh chicken (20%), chicken meal (20%), whole red lentils, whole green peas, chicken fat (8%), turkey meal (7%), fresh chicken giblets (liver, heart) (4%), herring meal (4%), eggs (4%), raw flounder (4%), fish oil (3.5%), whole chickpeas, whole green lentils, whole yellow peas, pea starch, raw turkey liver (0.5%), salt, dried kelp, fresh whole pumpkin, fresh whole butternut squash, fresh whole carrots, fresh whole apples, fresh whole pears, fresh whole zucchini, dried chicory root, fresh kale, fresh spinach, fresh turnip greens, fresh beet greens, fresh whole cranberries, fresh whole blueberries, fresh whole saskatoon berries, turmeric, milk thistle, burdock root, lavender, marshmallow root, rosehips

Analytical constituents

Crude protein 35% Fat content 22% Crude fibre 5% Crude ash 8% Moisture 12% Calcium 1.7% Phosphorus 1.1% Omega-3 fatty acids 1.2% Omega-6 fatty acids 2.7% DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) 0.4%
